headline: Government hikes windfall tax on diesel and ATF exports, zeros petrol duty
hook: Windfall tax tweaked on diesel and ATF
summary: The central government has revised windfall profit taxes, raising the special additional excise duty on aviation turbine fuel exports to ₹11 per litre from ₹10.50. Meanwhile, the export duty on petrol has been reduced to zero. These fortnightly revisions impact upstream oil producers and fuel exporters. Indian retail investors should monitor margins for domestic refiners like ONGC and Reliance Industries.
whats_next: Next fortnightly windfall tax revision in two weeks
why_it_matters: Refining margins shift for major fuel exporters.
winners_losers: Petrol exporters gain / ATF exporters hurt

headline: Centre scraps export duty on petrol while raising levies on diesel and ATF

These adjustments in export duties reflect shifting international product margins and domestic supply dynamics. Indian oil refiners will face altered export economics following these tax revisions.
